body.message:
I wanted to inform you that our check-out date is 9 June, but due to our flight schedule, we need to vacate the apartment earlier on 7 June at 9:00 AM.

Could you please let us know if someone will come to inspect and receive the apartment at that time?

Also, regarding the AED 2,000 deposit, could you please confirm how and when it will be returned? Will it be refunded at handover, by bank transfer, or in cash?

Thank you.
